given_by.match: Match each award to the group that gives it.

rows.label: Ballon d'Or
rows.hook: crowns the best soccer player of the season with a golden trophy

rows.label: Emmy Award
rows.given_by: National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences
rows.hook: honors the best shows and performers on the small screen, with separate primetime and daytime ceremonies

rows.label: Medal of Honor
rows.description: highest award for valor by an individual serving in the Armed Forces of the United States
rows.hook: is America's highest military decoration for valor in combat, presented in the name of Congress

rows.label: Grammy Awards
rows.given_by: National Academy of Recording Arts and Sciences
rows.description: American award for achievements in music
rows.hook: rewards achievements in music with a gilded gramophone trophy

rows.label: Fields medal
rows.description: prize awarded every four years to two, three, or four mathematicians under 40 years of age at the International Congress of the International Mathematical Union

rows.label: Nobel Prize in Literature
rows.description: one of five prizes established by Alfred Nobel
rows.hook: recognizes a writer's entire body of work, with the winner announced each October

rows.label: Victoria Cross
rows.description: highest military decoration awarded by the UK and the Commonwealth
rows.hook: is the top British decoration for valour in the face of the enemy

rows.label: Tony Awards
rows.description: awards to recognize the excellence in live Broadway theatre, presented by the American Theatre Wing and The Broadway League at an annual ceremony in New York City
rows.hook: honors the best plays and musicals on the New York stage at a ceremony each June

rows.label: Golden Lion
rows.description: highest prize given to a film at the Venice Film Festival

rows.label: Hugo Award
rows.description: set of awards given annually for the best science fiction or fantasy works and achievements of the previous year (1953–)

rows.label: Nobel Prize in Physics
rows.description: yearly physics award given by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
rows.hook: rewards groundbreaking discoveries about the fundamental forces and particles of the universe

rows.label: Righteous Among the Nations
rows.description: Israeli honorific for non-Jews who saved Jews during the Holocaust

rows.label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
rows.description: one of five Nobel Prizes established in 1895 by Alfred Nobel
rows.hook: rewards breakthroughs in understanding the human body and fighting disease

rows.label: Abel Prize
rows.given_by: Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters
rows.description: international prize presented by the King of Norway to one or more outstanding mathematicians, created in 2003
